meta.parties: Kingsley Fernando v. Dayaratne and Others

rules.statement: The use of the word 'may' in section 39A(1) of the Land Acquisition Act should generally be considered as permissive and not mandatory, unless modified by the context.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear from this passage that the use of the word 'may' should generally be considered as permissive and not mandatory. There could however be a modification of this general rule in view of the particular context of the provision."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 39A(1) of the Land Acquisition Act
